question: How to setup dynamic routes in Next.js?
answer: To set up dynamic routes in Next.js, you can create a new file with the same name as your route but with square brackets around the parameter. For example, if you have a blog post page, you can create a page called "blog/[slug]/page.tsx". The [slug] is a Dynamic Segment that will be used to fetch different content based on the value of the slug parameter.
